100 questions × 2 marks = 200 marks. 15 minutes for each section, one after the other (reported as new in 2026); you can’t go back to a section once its time is up.

Tier 1 decides who is called for Tier 2; check the notice for how each tier counts towards the final merit.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 58 right and 14 wrong in the whole paper:

58 × 2 − 14 × 0.5 = 116 − 7 = 109

On average, a blind guess among four options gains about 0.13 of a mark; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.75 of a mark.

SSC CHSL questions people ask

Is there negative marking in SSC CHSL Tier 1?

Yes. 0.5 of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and a right answer gets 2 marks. A skipped question costs nothing.

Does SSC CHSL Tier 1 have sectional timing?

Yes. You get 15 minutes each for English Language, General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude and General Awareness, 60 minutes in all, and you can’t go back to a section once its time is up.

Which sections are in SSC CHSL Tier 1?

4 sections: English Language (25 questions), General Intelligence (25 questions), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions), General Awareness (25 questions). 100 questions in all.

How can I practise SSC CHSL quant and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five quant and five reasoning, in SSC CHSL marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.

Is Takkar an official SSC website?

No. Takkar is an independent practice game and isn’t affiliated with any exam-conducting body. For notices, dates and results, see ssc.gov.in.
